clips.title: The story
paras: In Stonetalon, Gaxim Rustfizzle has a plan for the Scroll of Messaging. The gnome engineer means to use its sending spell to trigger remote explosives.

Gaxim Rustfizzle plans to turn a message into a blast at the Venture Company's logging operation. He will combine the scroll's transmission incantation with volatile NG-5 charges. The explosion is meant to distract the guards, giving operatives time to slip past and steal engineering schematics and confidential correspondence.
